evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Hey Dave! Sorry it took me so long to get back to you. Crazy times since we talked! My album finally dropped on the 11th and it was a wild feeling. Everyone's been loving it and it's motivated me to keep going.
[S18T1] (dia_id: D18:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Congrats on your album release - that's awesome! Has it been overwhelming or inspiring?
[S18T2] (dia_id: D18:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's been a lot. Seeing everyone get behind it has been awesome. It's kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it. It's also cool that it's connecting with people. It really motivates me to make even better music.
[S18T3] (dia_id: D18:3)

Dave: That's awesome, Calvin! It's such a great feeling when your work gets noticed and makes a positive difference. It must be really motivating for you to keep chasing your dreams.
[S18T4] (dia_id: D18:4)

Calvin: Yeah, moments like this remind me why I got into music - making a difference and sharing my own story. It's exciting to get positive feedback and it gives me strength to keep going and reach more people. My journey's just getting started!
[S18T5] (dia_id: D18:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! You've come a long way since we started talking music. What's next for you? Anything exciting coming up?
[S18T6] (dia_id: D18:6)

- On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of himself performing at a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table in a nightclub) with someone he admires — "So amazing!" (Dave: "You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?") (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S26T7][S26T8]. Calvin: performing "with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (complements his long-stated "fuels my soul"/concerts-are-what-he-lives-for remarks above; closing exchange details in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T9].
- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it.") [S27T10][S27T11][S27T12].
- On 2023-11-02, told Dave that last week (~2023-10-26) he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion (see ## New home (2023-03-23)) for his new album — "It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends!" (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked what it was like when everyone was cheering him on: "It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." [S28T4][S28T5].
- On 2023-11-02, said creating something that people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like the party "really motivate me to keep growing!" (complements his earlier "passion and purpose" remark of 2023-10-25, see above) [S28T7].

Calvin: Hey Dave! It's been a while! Crazy stuff has been happening. Last week I threw a small party at my Japanese house for my new album. It was amazing, so much love from my fam and friends! Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen]
[S28T1] (dia_id: D28:1)

Dave: Congrats on your album release and the party, Calvin! Must've been a great feeling having your loved ones show their support.
[S28T2] (dia_id: D28:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an awesome feeling seeing everyone come together to celebrate - super rewarding! Look at this photo showcasing how wonderfully we spent our time!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people dancing at a party]
[S28T3] (dia_id: D28:3)

Dave: Wow, great job, Calvin! Congrats! What was it like when everyone was cheering you on?
[S28T4] (dia_id: D28:4)

Calvin: It was incredible, Dave! The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this.
[Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing on top of a stage]
[S28T5] (dia_id: D28:5)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Creating something that brings people together and inspires them - that's really awesome!
[S28T6] (dia_id: D28:6)

- On 2023-05-03, said he's stuck with his music — "like [his] creativity's frozen" — and asked Dave for tips; said he'll take Dave's advice (take a break from music and explore other things for fun) to get his "mojo" back, and affirmed he won't give up on his music [S5T10][S5T11][S5T12][S5T14].
- On 2023-05-16, "super excited" for the Tokyo performance happening this month (May 2023) — a chance to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following (details in ## Tokyo trip) [S6T11]. The tour went ahead: as of 2023-05-31 he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (see ## Tokyo trip) [S7T1].
- As of 2023-06-09, has an album in progress ("my album"); met with the creative team for it on 2023-06-08 — "a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together", and he's "feeling stoked" and "making some magic" in the studio working on the music and everything. He shared a photo of the studio (a recording studio with a large window and a desk) [S8T1][S8T3].
- On 2023-05-31, said performing live "always fuels my soul" — he loves "the rush and connection with the crowd," "the feeling's indescribable — it's an absolute high"; at a concert "Everyone is part of it, it's like one big harmony." The chat came with concert photos (a large crowd taking pictures of a concert; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band performing on stage) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T12][S7T13][S7T14].
- As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists and promised Dave he'll share clips when everything's ready (details in ## Japan plan) [S10T12][S10T14].

Dave: Hey Calvin! Long time no chat! How was the end of your tour? I bet it was amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air]
[S16T1] (dia_id: D16:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! The tour was amazing! I was so pumped from all the energy from the audience. This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people watching a concert with a large screen]
[S16T2] (dia_id: D16:2)

Dave: Wow, that looks amazing! How was it performing on that big stage?
[S16T3] (dia_id: D16:3)

Calvin: Performing on such a big stage was a dream come true! The energy was incredible and I felt on top of the world. It was seriously surreal.
[S16T4] (dia_id: D16:4)

Dave: Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!
[S16T5] (dia_id: D16:5)

Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
[Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
[S16T6] (dia_id: D16:6)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Can't wait to see it. Will it be shot on location?
[S16T7] (dia_id: D16:7)

Calvin: We're doing the shoot in Miami and picked an awesome beach. It's going to have some epic visuals!
[S16T8] (dia_id: D16:8)

Dave: Sounds great, Calvin! The beaches in Miami are awesome - can't wait to see them!
[S16T9] (dia_id: D16:9)

Calvin: Oh man, they are amazing! I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!
[S16T10] (dia_id: D16:10)

- On 2023-08-22, when Dave asked if any other collaborations came out of the performance, said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together — "which is wild"; the collaborator's identity is not specified (a new collaborator besides Frank Ocean, or Frank Ocean himself — unconfirmed) [S15T10].
- On 2023-08-31 (octopus-guitar chat, see ## Octopus guitar), after Dave said his unique style really stands out in his music and playing, Calvin said he's glad Dave appreciates it: trying to stay true to himself and be unique in his music is something he values [S16T24].
- On 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("the 11th" as of 2023-09-13) — it was "a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, and it's motivated him to keep going [S18T1].
- On 2023-09-13, said it's been a lot: it's "kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it", but it's cool that it's connecting with people, and it really motivates him to make even better music; moments like this remind him why he got into music — making a difference and sharing his own story — and the positive feedback gives him strength to keep going and reach more people: "My journey's just getting started!" [S18T3][S18T5].
- On 2023-09-13, said what's next is a tour ("Next up, a tour - so excited!"), and after that he's off to explore and grow his brand — "Can't wait to see what the future has in store!" (Dave asked about cities or venues, but Calvin did not answer in this exchange) [S18T7][S18T8].

- On 2023-08-31, told Dave that last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) he started shooting a video for his new album (the album in progress since 2023-06-09, see ## Music) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location [S16T6][S16T7].
- The shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" [S16T8].
- Dave loves the beaches in Miami and can't wait to see them; Calvin: "I love the Miami vibe, it's perfect for the vid. Can't wait to show you!" [S16T9][S16T10].

- On 2023-05-31, reconnected with Dave ("been ages since we chatted") and told him the Frank Ocean tour the week before was "wild", including the "unreal" Tokyo show (details in ## Tokyo trip); Dave congratulated him [S7T1][S7T2]. Calvin thought Dave's car photo was of the car Dave had been fixing the engine of for a friend (Dave's neighbor; details in /memories/dave.md, section "Car maintenance shop"). The two also talked about how working on cars is relaxing: for Calvin it "chill[s]" him, "clears [his] head", "calms [him] down", and gives a real sense of achievement — "like meditating" — and Dave said the same applies to him (details in /memories/dave.md, section "Hobbies and sense of purpose") [S7T3][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6].
- The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed Dave's "feeling of power and happiness" from the transformation talk — "It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas" [S7T9]. Dave asked whether he always enjoys performing live (see ## Music), then what's next for his music; Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour — "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (see the Boston trip section above) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T14][S7T15]. Dave said he'll be at the Boston show to cheer him on [S7T16]. The 2023-05-31 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to [him]" — and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished him a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-06-09, caught up with Dave: told him about the creative-team album session (details in ## Music) and that he's "stoked" about the album; Dave shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees, and Calvin shared a photo of the studio (details in ## Music) and one of a tree with pink flowers (details in ## Boston trip) [S8T1][S8T2][S8T3][S8T5]. They talked about nature: Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Calvin, having never been to Boston, is "can't wait" to visit in July 2023 and asked about the Boston parks (details in ## Boston trip); when Calvin asked if Dave has been on any hikes recently, Dave said no but thinks hiking is awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; details on Dave's park habit and his Boston-parks stroll are in /memories/dave.md > ## Parks [S8T4][S8T5][S8T6][S8T7][S8T8]. Then Dave announced he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023), and Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to de-stress himself (details in ## Mountains and hiking); the two wished each other well for the trip and signed off "see you soon" (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T9][S8T10][S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, told Dave about the car accident and repair process (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)); Dave expressed sympathy that no one was hurt, asked about issues with the insurance process and how long it took, and asked about the mechanic in the garage photo [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].
